summary: Every course needs a C or better and at most 10 units may be taken pass/no pass; the three core courses need letter grades and a B. The audit checks one 5-unit statistics course, 10 units each of Methods & Skills and Theory, and 20 units of electives (any ARCHLGY course or a non-ARCHLGY course the emphasis lists name, with at most 5 units of research or independent study), each course counting toward one component only. ARCHLGY 103 is both a core course and the WIM course. ARCHLGY 130 needs 5 units; your capstone option, the field experience, the approval of your course plan by the student services officer and faculty director, and any petitioned outside course are checked by hand.
